node.statement: Choose a universal e_up>0 no larger than all preceding thresholds, the smallness radii in GT-kitaev-prop-delta-hominc, and a number satisfying 8*C_np*e_up<1/4. Then delta_n:=4d<=4*C_np*epsilon_X has 2*delta_n<1/4. Apply GT-kitaev-prop-delta-hominc to each fixed canonical v_n from node 1.3: the domain M_n(C^2) is an exact C*-algebra (hence an epsilon_X-C*-algebra), the codomain M_n tensor calX is an epsilon_X-C*-algebra by def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, node 1.5 supplies the delta_n-homomorphism property, and node 1.6 supplies eta=1/4. The external gives ||v_n||<=1+O(delta_n+epsilon_X) and ||v_n(x)||>=(1-O(delta_n+epsilon_X))||x||, with universal big-O coefficients independent of n and all input data.
